extraContent.description: The title 'Hymne de David, qu'il chanta à l'Éternel, au sujet de Cush, le Benjamite' is present in Translation v1. In OSMAIN, this text exists as the first sentence of v1 ('En shiggajon av David...'), but the translation splits the title and the prayer body into two separate verses (v1 and v2), whereas OSMAIN keeps them together in v1.

The word 'Sélah (pause)' is explicitly written out with the parenthetical explanation '(pause)'. OSMAIN v5 only contains 'Sela' without the explanatory text. This is a minor extra content addition in the translation.
